$comment: R1: the template for a new product. NEVER loaded (a file whose name starts with _ is skipped). Copy it to config/products/<id>.json and fill in every field. Every figure is the owner's: list a figure still under discussion in `proposals`.
id: the product id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, the same as the file name; stored as product_id on every job, run, routine, request, ledger row and event
name: the name shown in the Owner's office and Finance
status: active or archived (an archived product's lines refuse every start)
monthlyBudgetUsd: a positive number: the most this product may spend in a Dublin calendar month; the guard refuses a call past it
dailyCapUsd: optional: a positive number at most the station's caps.perDayUsd (null: the station's day cap applies)
jobCapUsdByDepartment: department id -> USD per job for this product's jobs in that department; never above the station's caps.perJobUsd (the lowest cap wins)
decided: figure -> who decided it and when
proposals: the figures that are proposals, not decisions
runChecks: check name -> argv (R2: run_check, inside Docker with --network none); optional
readOnlyApi: the product's read-only interface for the Station (R6), or null
policy: action -> level overrides; only stricter than config/autonomy.json (auto < owner < forbidden)
dataDir: products/<id>/ under the data root ("." is the archived Etsy layout only)
ownerApprovalRequired: true (the only value accepted: every outbound or irreversible action waits for the owner)
